          "expected_scene_count": 6,

        },
        "sections": [
          {

            "intent": "Rhea's economic exploit draws the attention of a desperate fellow arrival and a cynical, low-level system clerk.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",

                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"

                "location_end": "Outpost Perimeter",

                "location_end_label": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "location_start": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "Vance and Unit 734 confront Rhea about her bypassed transaction fee, demanding to know how she did it.",
                "scene_id": 1,
                "summary": "As Rhea finishes eating her nutrient paste, a battered arrival named Vance and a floating, cynical system clerk drone designated Unit 734 approach her. Vance noticed her untaxed transaction, and the drone is annoyed by the 'unsanctioned barter' alert.",

                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "empty nutrient paste tube",
                  "ashy ground",
                  "low mechanical hum",
                  "battered arrival"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "Rhea tosses the empty nutrient paste tube onto the ash, wiping her mouth as a low mechanical hum approaches the kiosk.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "kiosk chassis",
                  "iron bludgeon",
                  "floating drone",
                  "scarred man"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She backs against the kiosk chassis, gripping her iron bludgeon as the scarred man and the floating drone block her path.",

              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "detained",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:1",

                "hands_off_to": "3:3",
                "location_end": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_PERIMETER_CE205C",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "location_start": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_PERIMETER_CE205C",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "outcome": "Rhea negotiates a temporary truce, agreeing to demonstrate her exploit in exchange for Vance's combat protection and Unit 734's system access.",
                "scene_id": 2,
                "summary": "Vance threatens to report her unless she shares the exploit, while Unit 734 offers to ignore the alert if they cut it in on the profits to meet its own quota. Rhea realizes she cannot fight them both and proposes a formal party structure to exploit the system together.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "drone optical lens",
                  "red penalty warning",
                  "ashy dirt",
                  "battered arrival"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The drone's optical lens whirs, projecting a red penalty warning onto the dirt between Rhea and the battered arrival.",

                  "lowered iron bludgeon",
                  "extended hand",
                  "hovering machine",
                  "tense silence"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "She lowers the iron bludgeon, extending a hand toward the man while keeping a wary eye on the hovering machine.",

              }
            ],
            "section_id": 1,
            "title": "Unwanted Attention"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "The newly formed party successfully completes a rigged local quest with zero net loss to their resources.",
            "intent": "The trio tests a joint venture, combining Rhea's exploit with the arrival's combat skill and the clerk's limited system access.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:2",
                "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
                "hands_off_to": "3:4",
                "location_end": "Scavenger Den",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_SCAVENGER_DEN_B2B406",
                "location_end_label": "Scavenger Den",
                "location_start": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_PERIMETER_CE205C",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Perimeter",
                "outcome": "The party successfully farms the rats using the environmental damage loophole, generating untaxed loot while Vance absorbs the aggro.",
                "scene_id": 3,
                "summary": "Unit 734 pulls up a low-level 'Pest Control' quest that usually drains more durability than it pays out. Vance engages the scavenger rats in combat, deliberately avoiding killing blows, while Rhea uses the environment to finish them off, bypassing the combat tax.",
                "threads": [
                  "rhea_survival",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "glowing blue quest board",
                  "ruined concrete pillar",
                  "pest control bounty",
                  "scavenger rats"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The drone projects a glowing blue quest board onto the side of a ruined concrete pillar, highlighting a pest control bounty.",
                "transition_out_anchors": [
                  "crumbling wall",
                  "heavy stone slab",
                  "crushed rat skull",
                  "dust cloud"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Vance kicks a rat toward the crumbling wall, giving Rhea the perfect angle to drop a heavy stone slab on its skull.",
                "type": "action"
              },
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:3",
                "end_condition_echo": "The newly formed party successfully completes a rigged local quest with zero net loss to their resources.",
                "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
                "hands_off_to": "3:5",
                "location_end": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start": "Scavenger Den",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_SCAVENGER_DEN_B2B406",
                "location_start_label": "Scavenger Den",
                "outcome": "The party cashes out their combined loot, proving the synergy works and securing a net positive resource gain for all three.",
                "scene_id": 4,
                "summary": "They haul the untaxed loot back to the kiosk. Unit 734 uses its clerk access to mask the manual deposit as a 'maintenance flush,' allowing them to cash out the quest rewards and the raw materials without triggering the 40% transaction fee.",

                  "rhea_survival",
                  "system_debt_trap",
                  "party_alliance"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "sack of rat carcasses",
                  "ashy ground",
                  "blinking navigation light",
                  "automated kiosk"

                "transition_in_text": "Rhea drags the sack of rat carcasses across the ash, following the drone's blinking navigation light back to the automated kiosk.",

                  "rusted chute",
                  "heavy stream of copper coins",
                  "metal collection tray",
                  "grinding gears"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "The rusted chute spits out a heavy stream of copper coins, clinking loudly against the metal collection tray.",
                "type": "progression"
              }
            ],
            "section_id": 2,
            "title": "A Test of Synergy"
          },
          {
            "end_condition": "The System registers the party under a custom, highly restrictive liability contract.",
            "intent": "Formalize the party alliance using Rhea's strict, loophole-free legal wording to prevent future betrayal.",
            "scenes": [
              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:4",
                "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
                "hands_off_to": "3:6",
                "location_end": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Kiosk",

                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "copper coins",

                  "rejected prompt",
                  "scrolling green text",
                  "contract syntax",
                  "drone projector"
                ],
                "transition_out_text": "Rhea rejects the glowing blue invite prompt, forcing the drone to project the raw, scrolling green text of the contract syntax.",

              {
                "characters": [
                  "rhea_mercer",
                  "vance_harrow",
                  "unit_734"
                ],
                "constraint_state": "free",
                "consumes_outcome_from": "3:5",
                "end_condition_echo": "The System registers the party under a custom, highly restrictive liability contract.",

                "location_end_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_end_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "location_start_id": "LOC_OUTPOST_KIOSK_94640F",
                "location_start_label": "Outpost Kiosk",
                "outcome": "The System accepts the custom contract, officially forming the party and locking in their mutual obligations.",

                "threads": [
                  "party_alliance",
                  "system_debt_trap"
                ],
                "transition_in_anchors": [
                  "green text",
                  "scarred face",
                  "drone chassis",
                  "sickly light"
                ],
                "transition_in_text": "The green text of the custom contract hovers in the air, casting a sickly light over Vance's scarred face and the drone's chassis.",
                "type": "progression"
              }

            "section_id": 3,
            "title": "The Liability Contract"
          }
